title: Credit-account share of transaction volume, multi-account customers, 2025
prompt: Among customers with more than one account, what share of their total 2025 transaction volume happened on their credit-type account(s)? Are multi-account customers relying heavily on credit?
population: Customers with more than one account, and their 2025 transactions across all accounts.
metricDefinition: sum(2025 transaction amount on credit-type accounts) / sum(2025 transaction amount on all accounts), per customer, restricted to customers with more than one account.
transformationPlan: find customers with more than one account
aggregate their 2025 transaction volume, split into credit-account volume and total volume
compute the credit share per customer
referenceSql: WITH multi_account_customers AS (SELECT customer_id FROM accounts GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) > 1), txn_by_customer AS (SELECT a.customer_id, sum(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE a.account_type = 'credit') AS credit_volume, sum(t.amount) AS total_volume FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM multi_account_customers) AND t.occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND t.occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY a.customer_id) SELECT customer_id, credit_volume, total_volume, coalesce(credit_volume, 0) / total_volume AS credit_share FROM txn_by_customer
